title: MediaVod
description: media.vod@1: one recorded stream (VOD) as OpenVibe.Media's API answers it (server/vod/finalize.js vodPublic: GET /api/v1/:app/vods/:id, the list, and every read that returns a row). Its numeric id, its app-local user id, title and description, derived status (pending, recording, ready or failed), duration and size, the file basename, the URL its bytes play from (playback_url; hls_url is the master playlist when the object has one), thumbnail, storage provider, visibility, view counts, readiness and times. watch_id is the id openvibe.video addresses the watch page by (openvibe.video/watch?v=<watch_id>): 11 characters of URL-safe base64 from 8 random bytes, fixed for the row's life, never derived from the numeric id. More fields may be added; a consumer reads what it knows.

id.description: The VOD's numeric id inside Media. Internal: a watch page is addressed by watch_id.

watch_id.description: The id of its watch page on openvibe.video (openvibe.video/watch?v=<watch_id>): 8 random bytes as URL-safe base64, 64 bits. One id space across VODs and clips. Optional: a row written before the ids existed may answer without one until Media's backfill fills it.

app_id.description: The tenant that owns the recording (live, media-hub, games…).

user_id.description: The owning app's local user id; it is not a Network subject id.

status.description: Derived (db.vodStatus): recording while it is written, failed when its health quarantined it, ready once a file and a duration or size are there, pending before.

file_path.description: The file's basename only; a server path is never returned.

playback_url.description: The URL its bytes play from on openvibe.media.

preview_url.description: The hover preview of this item: about 6 s, muted, 320 px wide, MP4 H.264, stored beside its thumbnail and served at /p/<name>. Null until the preview.make job has made it (audio-only, private and too-short items never get one).

preview_webm_url.description: The same moment as preview_url, encoded as WebM (VP9, VP8 where the encoder has no VP9). Null while preview_url is.

visibility.description: public: anyone. unlisted: reached only by its exact id, never listed, noindex. private: missing to everyone but its owner and staff.

is_public.description: True only for visibility public (kept beside it for older readers).

readiness.description: The object's readiness levels (server/objects/readiness.js) when the read asked for them.

hls_url.description: The object's master playlist, when it has one (MEDIA_HLS_ENABLED).

created_at.description: UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' as the store keeps it.
